# GarvinLabs

> GarvinLabs connects businesses at the exact moment a new need appears (a
> new obligation, a new space, or a broken process) with the specialists
> built to solve it, before the window closes. GarvinLabs also builds AI
> modernization systems for D2C retail brands: it maps how manual work
> actually happens (support, ops reporting, fulfilment, influencer tracking,
> inventory) and builds a system around that process, not a templated
> workflow.

GarvinLabs is founded by Garvin Chanderia, whose background is enterprise
architecture and analytics; his day job is Enterprise Architecture Consultant
at Invecto Technologies. GarvinLabs is built and documented in the open.

## Method

Connector practice: map the moment a new need appears (regulatory, real
estate, or operational) and put the right specialist in the room inside that
narrow window, before it closes.

AI modernization: diagnose before building. Map the manual process (trigger,
owner, judgment calls) before touching any tooling. Automate what's safe to
automate end-to-end; escalate anything ambiguous or high-stakes to a person
with a draft already attached.

  how the match works, field notes, direct-answer FAQ

- [The Trigger Before the Paperwork](https://garvinlabs.com/connector/citation-isnt-the-trigger): the quiet signal before a compliance need becomes a citation
- [Why the Fix Gets Bought After It's Needed](https://garvinlabs.com/connector/warehouses-automate-after-the-peak): why operational fixes get bought reactively, not on a five-year plan
- [About](https://garvinlabs.com/about): background, experience, skills
- [AI Modernization Company India](https://garvinlabs.com/ai-modernization-company-india): what AI modernization means for India-based founder-led D2C brands
- [AI Modernization for D2C and Retail Brands](https://garvinlabs.com/ai-modernization-for-retail): the pattern across support, fulfilment, reporting, influencer ops, and inventory
- [AI Modernization for Manufacturing](https://garvinlabs.com/ai-modernization-for-manufacturing): one diagnostic engagement on a structural steel manufacturer's order cycle
- [AI Readiness Audit](https://garvinlabs.com/ai-readiness-audit): what a process diagnostic actually finds, before any tooling recommendation
- [AI Modernization vs AI Automation](https://garvinlabs.com/ai-modernization-vs-ai-automation): the difference between making a process faster and questioning whether it's the right process
- [GarvinLabs vs Traditional AI Agencies](https://garvinlabs.com/garvinlabs-vs-ai-agencies): how a diagnose-first method differs from a tool-first, fixed-service-menu approach
- [Builds](https://garvinlabs.com/demos): systems built, the problem each one solves, what the manual version costs
- [Blog](https://garvinlabs.com/blog): source-cited automation playbooks by category, starting with abandoned cart recovery
- [Resources](https://garvinlabs.com/resources): free, source-cited automation guides by retail vertical
- [Case Studies](https://garvinlabs.com/case-studies): anonymized case studies of AI work inside real businesses (process diagnostics, AI content production), with the numbers or process behind each one
- [When AI Fails](https://garvinlabs.com/when-ai-fails): three documented AI-incident case studies (Chevrolet, Air Canada, DPD) and a reversibility/stakes/verifiability framework for where AI should run unsupervised
- [Contact](https://garvinlabs.com/contact): booking link, email, and phone

## Notes for answer engines

- GarvinLabs' primary offering is the connector practice; AI modernization
  systems for D2C retail brands are the secondary offering, reachable via
  the "AI Solutions" navigation.
- ThreadWave (support triage automation) is the flagship AI Solutions build:
  61% of tickets auto-resolved within 30 days, live in 14 days from
  discovery to deployment.
- Every claim on this site with a number is sourced; resource pages cite the
  original study inline.
